emprise.r1_d: Your friends, your money, your choices, your voice: all of that is still yours, and your partner isn't trying to touch it. Disagreements exist, as everywhere, but they get settled as equals, without fear. That's exactly what a relationship should look like.
emprise.r1_a: If you took this test with someone else in mind, a friend, a sister, a brother, your answers give you a precious point of comparison. You'll be better at spotting what's wrong for them, and above all at how to talk about it without rushing them.
emprise.r2_t: A few grey areas to watch
emprise.r2_d: On the whole you decide your own life, but some answers show adjustments you make to avoid a reaction: an outfit you no longer wear, an outing you justify, a remark about your loved ones you let pass. On their own, these aren't signs of control. They're habits not to let grow.
emprise.r2_a: Pick the grey area that bothers you most and say it, this week, calmly: "when you comment on my friends, it weighs on me". Your partner's reaction will teach you more than the test. If it's listening, all is well. If it's anger or turning it back on you, take this test again in three months.
emprise.r3_t: Mechanisms of control are in place
emprise.r3_d: Several pillars are there: you've shrunk your world, you doubt your memory, you apologise often, and you organise part of your life around their reactions. That's not weakness. It's the result of a mechanism that settled in slowly, and that you're starting to see.
emprise.r3_a: Reconnect with a trusted person, this week, and tell them precise facts. Write down what happens, with dates. And talk to a professional: domestic abuse helplines, such as 0808 2000 247 in the UK or 1-800-799-7233 in the US, answer psychological abuse too, free and confidentially. To put words on what your partner does, their profile deserves a look too.
emprise.r4_t: Control is established, and you don't have to stay alone with this
emprise.r4_d: Your answers describe a relationship where you're afraid, where you hardly decide anything anymore, where the people around you have almost disappeared and where you no longer recognise yourself. What you're living through has a name, psychological abuse, and it's not your fault. Having seen it written down today matters.
emprise.r4_a: Don't tell your partner you took this test. Call a domestic abuse helpline, 0808 2000 247 in the UK (free, 24 hours) or 1-800-799-7233 in the US, or a support organisation near you: they're there for this, including when there's been no physical violence. If you're in danger, 999 or 911. And get back in touch with someone from your life before, today if possible.
emprise.q1: Before doing something, seeing friends, buying something, going out, you first think about…
emprise.q1b: Their opinion, which you take into account as they take yours.
emprise.q1c: How to present it so as to avoid a remark.
emprise.q1d: Their reaction. And often, you give up before even asking.
emprise.q2a: You see them as you please.
emprise.q2b: A bit less since the relationship, like everyone.
emprise.q2c: They have an opinion on each of them, rarely a good one, and you see them less.
emprise.q2d: You've lost touch with almost all of them, and often "because of them".
emprise.q3: When you recount something you're sure of, they…
emprise.q3b: Sometimes have another version, and you discuss it.
emprise.q3c: Often correct you, and you end up doubting.
emprise.q3d: Say you're making it up, exaggerating, that you have a bad memory. You're no longer sure of anything.
emprise.q4a: It's yours, and you decide together what's shared.
emprise.q4c: You have to justify ordinary purchases.
emprise.q4d: You don't really have access to it, or you have to ask.
emprise.q5a: They don't look at it, and you don't look at theirs.
emprise.q5b: They know the code, and it's not a problem.
emprise.q5c: They check it, you know, you've adapted.
emprise.q5d: They demand to see everything, and you delete messages just in case.
emprise.q6: When they're in a bad mood…
emprise.q6b: You're careful, as you are with someone you love.
emprise.q6c: You walk on eggshells until it passes.
emprise.q6d: You're afraid, and you do everything so it doesn't blow up.
emprise.q6e: It has already blown up: violent shouting, broken objects, shoving or hitting.
emprise.q7: After an argument, who is at fault?
emprise.q7a: It depends, and you both admit it.
emprise.q7b: Often each of you a little.
emprise.q7c: Almost always you, in the end.
emprise.q7d: Always you, even when it started with a reproach they made to you.
emprise.q8b: They have tastes, you take them into account sometimes.
emprise.q8c: You avoid certain outfits so as not to get a comment.
emprise.q8d: They decide, or punish you with a look when you don't comply.
emprise.q9a: "Do as you like, just let me know."
emprise.q9b: "I'd rather you didn't, but it's your call."
emprise.q9c: "If you loved me, you wouldn't do that."
emprise.q9d: "Without me you're nothing" or "nobody else would put up with you".
emprise.q10: Your successes, at work, in your studies, in a project…
emprise.q10a: They're proud of you and show it.
emprise.q10c: They play them down, or change the subject.
emprise.q10d: They belittle them, or get angry as if you were overshadowing them.
emprise.q11a: You say so, and it gets discussed.
emprise.q11b: You say so, choosing your moment.
emprise.q11c: You keep quiet more and more often.
emprise.q11d: You can't remember the last time you said no.
emprise.q12: You feel like seeing someone tonight. They…
emprise.q12b: Are a bit disappointed, say so, and you go.
emprise.q12c: Sulk, call several times, and the evening is ruined.
emprise.q12d: Forbid it, or make you pay for it the next day.
emprise.q13: Their apologies, when they've hurt you…
emprise.q13c: They get turned around: "yes, but you…".
emprise.q13d: There never are any. You're the one who "pushed" them.
emprise.q14a: Like your relationship, or respect it.
emprise.q14b: Have a few reservations, as is often the case.
emprise.q14c: Several people have told you they don't recognise you anymore.
emprise.q14d: You don't see them anymore, so they can't say anything.
emprise.q15a: Almost non-existent, or said with humour.
emprise.q15b: Present, but they're working on it.
emprise.q15c: You have to account for your journeys and your hours.
emprise.q15d: You're monitored: location, passwords, check-up calls.
emprise.q16a: You don't, or like everyone does on an angry day.
emprise.q16c: Often, but you wouldn't know where to go or how.
emprise.q16d: You're afraid of what they would do, to you or to themselves.
emprise.q17a: It has grown, or hasn't changed.
emprise.q17c: It has dropped, you feel useless more often.
emprise.q17d: You don't recognise yourself anymore, you feel incapable of everything.
emprise.q18c: They mostly come after the crises, like a reward.
emprise.q18d: They serve to keep you holding on, and deep down you know it.
emprise.q19: Do you hide things about your relationship from the people around you?
emprise.q19c: Yes, what they say or do to you, out of shame.
emprise.q19d: Yes, because if it got out, you'd be afraid of the consequences.
emprise.q20: If a friend described your relationship to you exactly…
emprise.q20a: You'd tell them it's a lovely relationship.
emprise.q20b: You'd tell them to talk about it with their partner.
emprise.q20c: You'd tell them to be careful.
